deviations.claim_in_article: “They enjoyed AI’s convenience, but a human was on the other end. They did not realize it.”
deviations.issue: The article asserts that users enjoyed the AI service and did not realize a human was handling the call. The Ledger reports inadequate disclosure, but does not establish users’ actual reactions or awareness.
deviations.explanation: The claim adds concrete facts about users’ experience and awareness that are not established by the Ledger. The nearby disclosure-related wording does not establish that users in fact failed to realize a human was handling their call.
deviations.qualifier_text: “might think AI was calling”; “If no one explained this clearly”
